verdict.rationale: Lambda documents tiered capacity offerings (self-serve on-demand, 1-Click Clusters, Private Cloud for 1,000+ GPUs) and a 'contact us for reserved capacity' path, which implies some limit/negotiation process, but there is no documented default quota per account, no explicit instance-limit numbers, and no defined self-service quota-increase request workflow. Missing for 10: explicit per-account default quotas/limits, a documented quota-increase request form or ticket process, and any confirmation this process works in practice.
